notes: Post is tagged Dark and is a Dark Side My Lord, Is That Legal? deck; side set to Dark (the draft had Light).

Starting cards as posted: the Objective, Prepared Defenses, Galactic Senate, Desert Landing Site, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, The Phantom Menace, plus '(One of the others.. depends on what they start with)' (an unnamed third effect, no row); all named starting cards count.
The list is posted without section counts and totals 61 as published.

The cards listed after the strategy under 'Some cards you might wanna put in this deck instead of others' (Maul Strikes, Crush the Rebellion, Emperor Palpatine, Sim Aloo, P-59, DVD LOTS, another Squabbling Delegates) are suggestions, not part of the deck; no rows.

Posted 'Galactic Senate' dested Coruscant: Galactic Senate; 'Kashyyk', 'Mos Espa Docking Bay' and 'Cantina' dested the Dark sites Kashyyyk (Dark), Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Dark) and Tatooine: Cantina (Dark); 'Death Star (P)' dested the Dark Death Star system.

Posted 'DV with lightsaber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Dr.E/PB' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Rune Haako' dested the Coruscant Rune Haako; 'Chimera' dested Chimaera; 'Mauls Ship' dested Maul's Sith Infiltrator.

Posted 'YCHF/MP', 'TINT/OE', 'Ability.. A.. A', 'Wipe the out all of them' and 'YOTC' dested You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Ability, Ability, Ability, Wipe Them Out, All Of Them and You Overestimate Their Chances.
